tools.name: ghl_agency_connection_health
tools.description: Check access to the connected sub-account and whether builder access is available.

tools.name: ghl_agency_tools_search
tools.description: Find tools and workflow templates by keyword or category.

tools.name: ghl_agency_tools_enable
tools.description: Choose read-only access or allow changes after a preview. Every change still requires dryRun=false and the returned preview ID.

tools.name: ghl_agency_contexts
tools.description: Show the sub-account selected during connection. Connect again to choose a different sub-account.

tools.name: ghl_agency_doctor
tools.description: Check the connected account and access to custom values, calendars, and workflows. Report unavailable permissions separately.

tools.name: ghl_agency_locations
tools.description: Read the location profile, timezone and configuration for the connected sub-account.

tools.name: ghl_snapshot_diff_audit
tools.description: Compare a supplied snapshot export with this sub-account's live custom values, custom fields, tags and calendars. Include the snapshot ID and at least one asset category. The export is user-supplied; its ownership and freshness are unverified. Missing categories remain unverified. This does not over

tools.name: ghl_site_builder_sync
tools.description: Read a funnel page or preview layout, style, copy, or content changes. Apply the returned preview to the same page. Existing checkout and upsell components must be preserved.

tools.name: ghl_domain_ssl_onboard
tools.description: Preview and save a domain record and funnel binding. Report DNS and HTTPS readiness separately. Hosting attachment, page routing and publication require separate steps.

tools.name: ghl_workflow_ivr_builder
tools.description: Preview a form-screening, intake, or call-menu workflow, then apply that preview. For multi-step-intake, provide formId and input.tags (one to ten existing tag IDs), input.taskTitle and input.taskBody. Draft creation and publication are separate requested actions.

tools.name: ghl_custom_values_audit
tools.description: Find blank custom values, unresolved placeholders, and broken references in the connected sub-account's message templates. Optional supplied templates are checked too.

tools.name: ghl_phone_wallet_audit
tools.description: Inspect connected-account phone numbers, number pools, missing routing, and forwarding loops. Routing risks do not establish charges or savings.

tools.name: ghl_user_role_governance
tools.description: Compare staff assigned to the connected sub-account with a selected permission preset. This audit does not change roles.
